title: TRI-K introduces TRIglyphix Soothe: advanced scalp soothing for lasting comfort
summary: Debuting at in-cosmetics Asia, this new ingredient helps formulators address sensitive scalp needs with visible benefits and a focus on comfort

title: Influencer Stella Tzortzi on building a brand inspired by Mediterranean hair oiling rituals
summary: Influencer Stella Tzortzi built Cee Cee from scratch. Now, the content creator is ready for the world to try her culturally-driven, natural hair care inspired by Mediterranean hair oiling rituals passed down from generation to generation

title: Cardi B brings Grow-Good Beauty to Canada
summary: Rapper Cardi B’s hair care brand, Grow-Good Beauty, launches direct to consumers in Canada, marking the ‘next chapter’ in the Dominican-inspired brand’s growth

title: Shiseido returns to profit in Q3 26, but Drunk Elephant records ‘severe underperformance’
summary: Despite returning to profit, Drunk Elephant global sales decreased 23% during the quarter after recording ‘some severe underperformance’ in US e-commerce sales

title: Phlur opens festive pop-up with Space NK to ‘build’ hype around Heavy Cream franchise
summary: Phlur has teamed up with the UK beauty retailer on a festive activation to promote the masstige fragrance brand’s new Heavy Cream Eau de Parfum and Heavy Cream Body Butter, alongside Space NK exclusive Cashmere Frost Hair & Body Mist

title: Indie brand Monte Club is shaking up the tired male grooming industry
summary: With male grooming moving at a glacial pace at times, indie hair care brand Monte Club wants to make a difference in the stagnant category. Find out how its Pure Beauty Award-winning product and stellar marketing are making a difference

title: Olaplex helps Henkel’s sales in Q3 as hair care acquisitions set to boost growth
summary: Henkel’s newly acquired hair care brands Olaplex and Not your Mother’s are expected to help deliver ‘above-average growth’ and €2bn of annual sales by 2030

title: Sol de Janeiro and Smashbox among brands donating $83 million excess stock in new initiative
summary: Vessel, a new start-up with $5 million backing, aims to solve the issue of excess inventory going to landfills or incineration in the beauty industry and beyond, with brands Sol de Janeiro and Smashbox taking part in the new initiative

title: Why do chemicals in beauty products have a bad reputation? How better science communication can tackle misinformation
summary: In an era of widespread misinformation, inaccurate science communication is rife. In his keynote speech at the CTPA Scientific Conference, Beta Montemayor tackled how the industry can start to rewire the public perception of chemicals

title: From twist to drop: Meet Virospack autofill
summary: Virospack presents Autofiller push button dropper, a new solution designed to enhance the application experience through a combination of intuitive functionality, precision, and premium design. Designed especially for serums, oils, and low-viscosity formulas, Autofiller integrates automatic formula intake, controlled drop-by-drop dispensing, and a pipette designed to facilitate precise and targeted application in a single system. A solution that responds to the evolution of beauty rituals by a sensory application experience.
